stage0068b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Reports from all teams say
　there's still no lead on the mystery AS.」

stage0068b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Continue the investigation.
　Any delay, and north and south will clash on their own.」

stage0068b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Are you thinking of Sergeant Sagara?」

stage0068b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「We've recovered the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$
　and rechecked the Lambda Driver systems.」

stage0068b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I suppose I needn't ask the result...」

stage0068b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Yes...
　No abnormalities were found in the system.」

stage0068b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So the problem lies with him after all...」

stage0068b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「...Captain, report from Team 12.
　They've found the mystery AS and an apparent ally unit.」

stage0068b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「An ally, you say...!
　Wasn't it operating alone!?」

stage0068b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It must mean it no longer needs to act alone.」

stage0068b_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「What do you mean?」

stage0068b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We may have misunderstood the situation.
　The mystery AS's goal wasn't to turn Hong Kong
　into a battlefield, but to lure us out.」

stage0068b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The Ptolemaios has arrived as well.」

stage0068b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We'll leave the interception to them.」

stage0068b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've recovered everyone except Sagara, desu.」

stage0068b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$フェルト$$
「He's not responding to our hails either.
　By $n's report, he's acting alone.」

stage0068b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Don't tell me he's... going to stay like this...」

stage0068b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Taking down the mystery AS comes first.
　Give the order to launch to all units.」

stage0068b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Quite the motley unit, isn't it.」

stage0068b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$デュオ$$
「At this point, I'm starting to doubt
　Amalgam's really behind this.」

stage0068b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「But the commander's unit is Lambda Driver-equipped.」

stage0068b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$玉芳$$
（My role is finished...
　All that's left is to fight $c until
　sensei settles things with that man）

stage0068b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$玉芳$$
（$$玉蘭$$...
　I may never see you again）

stage0068b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He's no use as combat strength like this.
　Then it's better he doesn't sortie.」

stage0068b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$n
「I know that without being told!
　But he's...!」

stage0068b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$n
「...He's... the first friend I made at Jindai High...」

stage0068b_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クルツ$$
「OK, $n.
　I get how you feel.」

stage0068b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It'd bug me to just take that idiot's grief.
　Let's mop up this noisy bunch fast
　and go pick up that silent type.」

stage0068b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack.
　Target the leader's unit.」

stage0068b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「The enemy has a Lambda Driver.
　Don't let your guard down.」

stage0068b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ベック$$
「Ohh, working hard, aren't you, $$玉芳$$.
　Well... put on a big show
　with the muscle I hooked you up with.」

stage0068b_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ベック$$
「Ow! That hurt, dammit!
　You run into people and don't even say sorry!

stage0068b_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ダヴ$$
「Boss, you sure you don't need to settle the score?」

stage0068b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「A scrawny guy like that, one punch and he's done.」

stage0068b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ベック$$
「Leave it.
　That guy... he's already dead.」

stage0068b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Not even one punch, dropped with a fingertip!?」

stage0068b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ベック$$
「That's not it.
　I mean his heart's basically already dead.」

stage0068b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, capture the Lambda Driver-equipped unit!
　Make sure to secure the operator too,
　so we can confirm who's behind this!」

stage0068b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$玉芳$$
「I won't be taken alive in disgrace...!」

stage0068b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スザク$$
「Chasing the enemy comes first right now!」

stage0068b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't move carelessly!
　Something's coming!」

stage0068b_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You've been a bit too naughty, Lolita～」

stage0068b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Anyway, I've gone and killed
　all of Lolita's little friends.」

stage0068b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$クルツ$$
「There's a whole bunch of Lambda
　Driver-equipped units!」

stage0068b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マオ$$
「Looks like this side's Amalgam after all.」

stage0068b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This old man's been looking for you... $$玉芳$$.
　Running wild in an unplanned area like that...」

stage0068b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Starting a war has to be planned, no-no～!
　You can't just do whatever you please.」

stage0068b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$玉芳$$
「I hear Amalgam had a hand
　in the civil war that cost us our home too.
　If we can avenge that, my sister and I have no regrets.」

stage0068b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hmm? A sister, huh...
　Oh, that's right! I've got a special guest!」

stage0068b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「As expected of big sis!
　You can tell it's your sister even like this～!」

stage0068b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「My bad, my bad!
　I really wanted to let you two meet
　in a bit better shape, but...」

stage0068b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Guess I played around a little too much～.
　Believe it or not, this old man
　really loves playing with dolls!」

stage0068b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh, mad? You're mad after all?
　Thought so～.」

stage0068b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Come now, out of respect for the wonderful
　sideburns of this strong, sexy $$ゲイツ$$...」

stage0068b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buhahahaha!
　Ahh, that felt great! $$ゲイツ$$'s in top form!」

stage0068b_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「N-No...!
　What is with that guy!?」

stage0068b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's twisted... all of it!」

stage0068b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now then... you fine folks of $c!
　Thanks to you, my Amalgam's very own
　Lambda Driver force is finally complete!」

stage0068b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「All thanks to you helping me
　gather data back in $$ヘルマジスタン$$!
　Yeah, makes me happy!」

stage0068b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Here's my thanks!
　I'll let you serve as my unit's
　glorious first opponent!」

stage0068b_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ベック$$
「Whoa, hold up!
　Don't go killing my client
　and then get all excited on your own!」

stage0068b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That color scheme, borderline tacky, I've seen it before!」

stage0068b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$!
　So you got out of Paradigm City too!」

stage0068b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ベック$$
「Yeah!
　Long time, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

stage0068b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you're the one who arranged that motley army earlier.」

stage0068b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What's this, what's this.
　A tacky bearded guy showed up.」

stage0068b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ベック$$
「Shut it, Sideburns!
　I still hadn't gotten paid
　by that $$玉芳$$ girl!」

stage0068b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「My apologies for that.
　...So, how about this?
　Help me with my work, and I'll pay you myself.」

stage0068b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ベック$$
「Oh!
　You're more reasonable than you look!」

stage0068b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Heh... call it respect for that lovely machine.」

stage0068b_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ベック$$
「And you've got good taste too!」

stage0068b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The birth of the worst duo...!」

stage0068b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ベック$$
「Let's get to it then, brother!」

stage0068b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「To prepare that many Lambda
　Driver-equipped units...」

stage0068b_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Countering that will require his strength too.」

stage0068b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now then, it's party time!
　Let's enjoy!!
　The night's only just begun!」

stage0068b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Tch!
　Two weirdos now, and things are worse than ever!」

stage0068b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess a Lambda Driver takes a Lambda Driver!
　Where the hell's that guy wandering off to!」

stage0068b_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't whine, Weber!
　Even if Sagara comes back, as far as combat strength...」

stage0068b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I understand how you feel, but don't speak from wishful thinking.」

stage0068b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$n
「It's not hope, it's certainty!
　That guy is not the type to end up like this!」

stage0068b_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$マオ$$
（Friends are a good thing to have.）

stage0068b_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Bet there's a kitten fretting away
　back on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, too.）

stage0068b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Let's wait.
　For word from him.」

stage0068b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$クルツ$$
「How devoted, $$テッサ$$.
　The woman who waits, huh.」

stage0068b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You could hear the bridge conversation!?」

stage0068b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It seems the line was left open.」

stage0068b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So that's how it is.」

stage0068b_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カレン$$
「We caught it all, right up to
　'If you wish it, I'll admit it...'」

stage0068b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Can't let $$テッサ$$ be the only one embarrassed.」

stage0068b_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, turn on your external speakers.」

stage0068b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「You idiot!
　How long are you gonna keep slacking off!!」

stage0068b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Quit slacking off already!
　Come on, you brooder!」

stage0068b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hey, you!
　We don't have the luxury
　to just sit and watch!」

stage0068b_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$宗介$$!
　Even being late has its limits!」

stage0068b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Hurry up.
　We need your strength too.」

stage0068b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Come, $$宗介$$.
　To keep living... to fight.」

stage0068b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You're a hopeless guy, but
　everyone still likes you.」

stage0068b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If you can't live up to that,
　then you really are hopeless!」

stage0068b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Position data has come in from Sergeant Sagara!」

stage0068b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am!
　Launching the ARX-7!」

stage0068b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（My thanks, $$星刻$$.
　So you guided $$五飛$$.）

stage0068b_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アル$$
「Affirmative.
　The Lambda Driver activated, for certain.」

stage0068b_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$宗介$$
「It works, it doesn't work. An erratic device.」

stage0068b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to be better at jokes than I am.」

stage0068b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Perth 1 to $$ウルズ$$ 7.
　Are you back in form?」

stage0068b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Then do as you please!」

stage0068b_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You brooder!
　Make up for being late and work hard!」

stage0068b_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「The Arbalest, huh!?
　Showing up now, what's the idea!」

stage0068b_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宗介$$
「Let's go, $$アル$$!
　No enemy can stand against us now!」

stage0068b_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Damn it!
　My sideburns are still alive!」

stage0068b_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「My horoscope's the worst today!
　I'm outta here!」

stage0068b_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What's going on!?
　Wasn't $$ミスリル$$'s Lambda Driver
　supposed to be unstable!?」

stage0068b_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What is that strength!?
　Damn you! Just who are you!?」

stage0068b_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ベック$$
「Tch!
　That's what you get for relying on sideburns of all things!!」

stage0068b_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Now I can finally get some sleep.」

stage0068b_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I did tell you to trust your own strength...
　but this is overdoing it, Sergeant.」

stage0068b_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$刹那$$
「So you were able to change.」

stage0068b_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アル$$
「That battle's result was remarkable, by any measure.
　If possible, could you tell me the reason why?」

stage0068b_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$宗介$$
「A small problem got resolved.
　That's probably all it is.」

stage0068b_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$アル$$
「I don't understand the meaning of that answer.」

stage0068b_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Can I leave the Arbalest to you?」

stage0068b_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 7 will now move to the next mission.
　I'll leave the rest to our allies.」

stage0068b_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wait, Sergeant!
　You're violating orders again...!」

stage0068b_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He took up a mission he found for himself.」

stage0068b_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That's how it should be, $$宗介$$.）

stage0068b_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ベック$$
「Damn it!
　Nothing in this world ever goes right!」

stage0068b_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Villains fall.
　That's just the way the world works, $$ベック$$.」

stage0068b_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ベック$$
「Shut your mouth!
　Next time, I'll get my revenge for sure!!」

stage0068b_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I admire the spirit, but I've no wish to see you again.」

stage0068b_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too bad, brother.
　If you'd grown sideburns instead of a beard,
　you might've had a chance too...」

stage0068b_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$...
　The world without war you dreamed of...）

stage0068b_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（I'll find it, I swear.
　That's all that's left for me now.）

stage0068b_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「So you finally got the Lambda Driver running!
　I've been waiting, baby!」

stage0068b_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no time to waste on someone like you.」

stage0068b_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That joke's a bit harsh!
　$$ゲイツ$$ here is Amalgam's leader, you know?
　The so-called final boss, that's me!」

stage0068b_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Is there a stronger foe than me!?
　No, there isn't!」

stage0068b_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Classes, you say!?
　Does $$ミスリル$$ teach you culture too!?」

stage0068b_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$宗介$$
「To me, it's a place more important than $$ミスリル$$...!
　And there, an enemy greater than you awaits!」

stage0068b_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$宗介$$
「The summer homework I still haven't finished!!」

stage0068b_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「$$キリコ$$, baby!
　Back on $$アレギウム$$...」

stage0068b_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What!
　$$ゲイツ$$'s witty talk was just...」

stage0068b_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I said not one word more.」

stage0068b_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Could it be... you're that
　Vice Minister Darlian thing?」

stage0068b_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Right, that's what I thought!
　Man, $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion
　got me excited too!」

stage0068b_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「To think that in that memorial hall,
　$$リリーナ$$ and $$ナナリー$$ were made into
　bunny girls by that lecher $$デキム・バートン$$...」

stage0068b_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I know all about you!
　You're $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$, right?」

stage0068b_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Then let's do it together!
　$$刹那$$ F. SAY YEAH!!」

stage0068b_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You've got no rhythm!
　One more time!
　$$刹那$$ F. SAY YEAH!!」

stage0068b_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Mind if I say something that's bothered me?」

stage0068b_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Your name, $$ゼロ$$... Z-ERO...
　does that mean 'the last Eros'?」

stage0068b_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Yeeeehaaa!
　I scored a point off that $$ゼロ$$!」

stage0068b_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You are too dangerous...!
　In more ways than one!」

stage0068b_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Come on, negotiator!
　When it comes to talk, even $$ゲイツ$$
　has a bit of confidence.」

stage0068b_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Wait! Hold on!
　Listen to what people say for once!」

stage0068b_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If my opponent were human, I would attempt dialogue!
　But if it's some kind of monster, that's different!」

stage0068b_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Whoa! As expected of a negotiator!
　You admit my strength, huh!」

stage0068b_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This is exactly why I don't want to talk to you...!」

stage0068b_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just this once, I'll abandon my duty!
　$$ビッグオー$$! Aaaction!!」

stage0068b_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I looked into you two as well,
　you indecent Boy & Teacher.」

stage0068b_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You're so naughty!
　Getting cozy with your good-looking student
　in a cramped cockpit!」

stage0068b_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Nufufu... I want you to give
　$$ゲイツ$$ a private lesson too～!」

stage0068b_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I've always tried my hardest
　to guide $n as their teacher...!
　But that... that...」

stage0068b_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「'Feel my chest, Miss $$スズネ$$'... is what you said!
　Well, in that costume, you'd
　get funny ideas too, huh.」

stage0068b_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「D-do it, $n!
　Show no mercy, until they're blown to bits!!」

stage0068b_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「'Without mercy, blown to Boob-$$ジン$$'... she said!
　Naughty, really!」

stage0068b_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ベック$$
「It's been a while, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

stage0068b_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I, for one, didn't even want to see your face.」

stage0068b_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ベック$$
「Don't get so full of yourself!
　That's my line!」

stage0068b_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ベック$$
「We meet again, 12,000 years later!
　Today, I'll finally settle this!」

stage0068b_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Wait, $$ベック$$!
　What does that 12,000 years even mean!?」

stage0068b_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ベック$$
「How should I know!
　It's just a number that popped into my head!」

stage0068b_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（This coincidence... I can't believe it's mere chance...）

stage0068b_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（The ring of 12,000 years, and
　the lost memories of Paradigm City's people...
　what connection could there be...）

stage0068b_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$五飛$$
（Nataku...
　Within your arms dwell the hopes
　and wishes of so many people.）

stage0068b_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$五飛$$
（My own, my comrades'... and that person's...!）

stage0068b_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$五飛$$
（Run, twin-headed dragon!
　From here on, this is our true battle!!）

stage0068b_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Move out!
　We can do this, as we are now!!」
